_comment: Permanent i18n text-layer fixtures. Each entry is rendered to PDF and its extracted text is diffed against `source`. A script may only be claimed as supported once its text-layer verdict is PASS. Visual rendering is a SEPARATE gate (Gate B1) and never substitutes for this one.
_oracle: poppler pdftotext. Do NOT switch to PyMuPDF - it misreports Devanagari conjuncts and produces false failures.
